objective: Complete a protected System Admin priority inbox that surfaces actionable BUKLOD help, advertisement, approval, finance, content safety and privacy requests with correct counts, origin-specific BSOC reply routing and no false completion, then prepare the changes for a future consolidated Android OTA and Expo Web RC.
productionBaselineEvidence: Source inspection of canonical GitHub Main on 2026-11-12. Feature branch forked from b89848c5; newer Main commits include independent security migrations. Production Android OTA runtime/source and Expo Web served bundle were not independently verified for this work. Source-only comparison is not a production release.
chosenApproach: Reuse existing System Admin screens, role checks, RLS and authenticated source RPCs; aggregate compact read-only pending records in a bounded in-app queue, keep exact BSOC counts, sample oldest/newest cases, and deep-link into the secure BSOC case thread with replies. Use focus/foreground/reactive updates and a visible incomplete-source warning. No new database, native package or privileged mutation.
selectionRationale: Existing pending records and source-specific approvals are already canonical; a parallel admin-request table would introduce synchronization drift and risk auto-marking incomplete work done. Direct case linkage addresses the older-ticket discoverability and reply problem without broadening access.
alternativeApproaches: Create a new global admin_notifications writable table and backfill all sources: rejected as a duplicated source of truth with complicated triggers and migration risk.
Use only unread notifications as the pending queue: rejected because read_at does not indicate resolution, older unnotified requests disappear, and users would be unable to locate original work.
preserveBehaviors: System Admin and BSOC read/manage RLS/RPC gates remain the sole authorities for case visibility and replies; no member can approve paid ads or inspect other users' private files.
Payment verification, withdrawal, points, advertising publication and account deletion are never triggered by opening or reading a notification.
Existing sponsor approval, BSOC chat, recovery, content moderation, attendance and privacy screens remain the definitive handlers.
Existing media, Wall, Marites, Connect, ads, points, offline caches, profile navigation, Expo runtime and mobile release configuration remain unchanged.
Reading an alert is independent of closing its underlying support or financial request; failed source reads are shown instead of silently reporting zero.
acceptanceChecks: Admin dashboard shows actionable priority badge even if the separate executive stats RPC fails, without exposing requests to unauthorized users.
Admin inbox filters Help, Ads, Approvals, Safety, Privacy and Urgent, counts pending BSOC precisely and visibly labels bounded partial results.
More than 100 BSOC cases still include newest and oldest unresolved cases, with direct case-specific thread opening for older cases and protected admin reply action.
BSOC notification clicks use strictly validated case UUID deep links and only mark the individual notification read, not the case resolved.
Age-based urgency escalates after 72 hours, rejects invalid dates, handles stale case response race and refresh without duplicate mutations.
Focused native Node behavioral tests and existing source/security contracts pass; full typecheck, authenticated RC build and release gates remain prerequisites before OTA publish.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Add an isolated authorized System Admin priority inbox and origin-linked BSOC request navigation while preserving all unrelated runtime screens, account boundaries and release behavior.
preservedBehaviors: Member and BSOC staff authorization remains enforced by existing backend RLS and scope-specific permission checks; app-wide media and navigation remain unchanged.
